initScript: (() => { const push=(o)=>{ try{ const c=JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('__errLog')||'[]'); c.push(o); sessionStorage.setItem('__errLog', JSON.stringify(c.slice(-30))); }catch(e){} }; const oe=console.error; console.error=function(){ push({t:Date.now(), args:[...arguments].map(a=>{ try{ return typeof a==='string'?a:JSON.stringify(a).slice(0,200) }catch(e){ return String(a) } }).join(' | ').slice(0,500)}); return oe.apply(this,arguments); }; })();

steps.code: (() => { const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"],[aria-label]')]; const hit=all.filter(e=>/权限|完全访问|仅查看|工作区内编辑/.test((e.innerText||'')+' '+(e.getAttribute('aria-label')||''))); return JSON.stringify(hit.map(e=>({tag:e.tagName, aria:e.getAttribute('aria-label'), t:e.innerText.trim().slice(0,20), r:[Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().x),Math.round(e.getBoundingClientRect().y)]}))); })()
